Tools.title: Pregnancy and ovulation calculators
Tools.description: Estimate your due date and your ovulation days.
Tools.disclaimer: Results are estimates only and do not replace a doctor's visit. Real dates vary from woman to woman.
Tools.lastPeriod: First day of your last period
Tools.invalidDate: Please choose a valid date within the last 42 weeks.

dueDate.title: Due date calculator
dueDate.description: Estimate your due date and how many weeks pregnant you are from your last period.
dueDate.age: Today you are {weeks} weeks and {days} days pregnant
dueDate.how: We add 280 days (40 weeks) to the first day of your last period. This is the usual way to estimate a due date; an early pregnancy ultrasound dates the pregnancy more accurately.

ovulation.title: Ovulation calculator
ovulation.description: Find your expected ovulation day and most fertile days.
ovulation.cycleHint: From the first day of one period to the first day of the next. Usually 28 days.
ovulation.how: Ovulation usually happens about 14 days before the next period. The most fertile days are the 5 days before ovulation, ovulation day and the day after. If your cycle is irregular the result is less accurate; a follicle-tracking ultrasound is the best way to confirm ovulation.
